concept:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single full-body character design on transparent background, matching an existing smooth 2D comic military animal game.
Reference images: STYLE ONLY: clean bold outlines, playful cel shading, cute compact proportions. Create a NEW CAT, not the dog or existing mechanic.
Primary request: a fat, stocky ginger tabby CAT with very narrow squinting eyes, wearing a plain olive-green Vietnamese pith helmet (mũ cối), intended for close melee combat. A huge round belly, broad chubby cheeks, very small confident squinting eyes, tiny cheeky smirk, little triangular feline ears and short whiskers. Short thick arms, big padded paws in dark brown fingerless gloves, stout legs and heavy boots. He must read unmistakably as a FAT CAT brawler, not a slim soldier with a large head.
Costume: round olive-green Vietnamese pith helmet with a broad circular brim, simple olive fabric band and brown chin strap; NO steel helmet, no goggles. Olive khaki button-up military shirt stretched smoothly over a round belly, rolled short sleeves, dark brown belt below the belly, loose straight long olive cargo trousers, dark brown boots. Short curved ginger-striped tail. No scarf, no backpack, no extra pouches obscuring the belly.
Pose: relaxed ready stance, full body facing right in 3/4 side view, both closed paws visible beside the belly, feet on one level, empty hands. Weighty, funny and sturdy. The belly is broad and rounded from chest down to the belt.
Style: polished non-pixel smooth 2D comic game sprite, clean consistent dark outlines, warm cel-shading, readable at small size, same art family as references. Friendly but determined melee fighter.
Constraints: ONE character only, entire pith helmet to both boot soles visible with transparent margin. Actual transparent RGBA background; no checkerboard painted in, no text, no labels, no ground shadow, no motion blur, no weapon, no national insignia, no photorealism, no pixel art.
